fusions.name: Practised Juggle
fusions.desc: Throws 3 stones at once in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. Each stone has 25% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Copied Form
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 26 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Do It Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Watched and Learned
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
